input.description: Beagle Rescue of Southern Maryland (BRSM), Inc. posted 3 hours ago. The post is about a beagle named Belle who is nervous and scared in the noisy shelter. They believe Belle would be more relaxed in a home setting with a soft bed, quieter surroundings, tasty treats, and belly rubs. Belle is a 3-year-old, 18-pound tricolor beagle girl with beautiful blue-tick type ticking. She came to the shelter as a stray, and her story is yet to be told. They mention that they can take care of Belle's vetting needs if someone can offer her a soft bed and human kindness. A link to the foster/adopter application is provided: https://beaglemaryland.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/BRSM_Adopter_App.pdf
